title: Dating App Use Fell 16% As Burnout Spread
hook: Swiping promised connection, but users increasingly describe it as exhausting work.
closing: Dating apps lose value when the search for connection leaves users emotionally drained.
question: Have you deleted a dating app?

segments.say: Tinder lost 7 million US monthly users. The category's biggest name was not immune to the retreat.
Combined dating app usage fell 16 percent. The decline reaches beyond one platform.
78 percent of dating app users report feeling drained. Burnout helps explain why people stop swiping.
